chapter.heading: The Humiliation of Babylon
chapter.v:
“Come down
and sit in the dust,O virgin daughter of Babylon;Sit on the ground without a throne,O daughter of the Chaldeans!For you shall no more be calledTender and delicate. [Is. 15:1-16; Jer. 25:21; Ezek. 25:8- 11; Zeph. 2:8-11 Abrahams nephew (see Gen. 19:36–38). Thus Ammon was re-] [2 Kin. 3:26,]

Take the
millstones and grind meal.Remove your veil,Take off the skirt,Uncover the thigh,Pass through the rivers. [Jer. 48:24,]

Your nakedness
shall be uncovered,Yes, your shame will be seen;I will take vengeance,And I will not arbitrate with a man.” [Num. 24:17; Jer. 48:7]

As for
our Redeemer, the Lord of hosts is His name,The Holy One of Israel. [2 Kin. 17:19; Hos. 12:2; Amos 3:2 f Lev. 26:14 g Is. 9:15, 16; 28:15; Jer. 16:19; Hab. 2:18] [Jer. 9:14; 16:11, 12; Ezek. 20:13,]

“Sit in
silence, and go into darkness,O daughter of the Chaldeans;For you shall no longer be calledThe Lady of Kingdoms. [Jer. 17:27; Hos.]

I was
angry with My people;I have profaned My inheritance,And given them into your hand.You showed them no mercy;On the elderly you laid your yoke very heavily. [Judg. 2:17-20; 2 Kin. 17:7-18; 18:12; Ezek. 22:1-] [Is. 29:21 l Joel 3:3; Amos 4:1; 5:11; 8:6; Mic.]

And you
said, ‘I shall be a lady forever,’So that you did not take these things to heart,Nor remember the latter end of them. [Amos 5:12] [Lev. 18:6-8; Ezek. 22:11 o Lev. 20:3; Ezek. 36:20-22]

But these
two things shall come to youIn a moment, in one day:The loss of children, and widowhood.They shall come upon you in their fullnessBecause of the multitude of your sorceries,For the great abundance of your enchantments. [Gen. 15:16; Num. 21:25; Deut. 2:31; Josh. 10:12] [Ezek. 31:3 t Is. 5:24; Ezek. 17:9; [Mal. 4:1]]

“For you
have trusted in your wickedness;You have said, ‘No one sees me’;Your wisdom and your knowledge have warped you;And you have said in your heart,‘I am, and there is no one else besides me.’ [Ex. 12:51; Amos 3:1; 9:7] [Deut. 2:7]

Therefore evil
shall come upon you;You shall not know from where it arises.And trouble shall fall upon you;You will not be able to put it off.And desolation shall come upon you suddenly,Which you shall not know. [Num. 12:6]

“Stand now
with your enchantmentsAnd the multitude of your sorceries,In which you have labored from your youth—Perhaps you will be able to profit,Perhaps you will prevail. [Is. 30:10; Jer. 11:21; Amos 7:13, 16; Mic. 2:6]

You are
wearied in the multitude of your counsels;Let now the astrologers, the stargazers,And the monthly prognosticatorsStand up and save youFrom what shall come upon you. [Is. 1:14]

Behold, they
shall be as stubble,The fire shall burn them;They shall not deliver themselvesFrom the power of the flame;It shall not be a coal to be warmed by,Nor a fire to sit before! [Jer. 46:6 b Ps. 33:16; Jer. 9:23]

Thus shall
they be to youWith whom you have labored,Your merchants from your youth;They shall wander each one to his quarter.No one shall save you.
